bilateral_transfer.both_arms_indexed: each record's 29 custody tokens are produced inside the timed call, as the enclave does in the same round trip
bilateral_transfer.custodian_keys_note: actors enrolled by (role, id): the evidence store signs the release, the lab custodian witnesses it and signs the receipt; both keys checked distinct and both signatures verified outside the timer

cases.epochs_are: sealing epochs of epoch_records records each, closed by count in stream order, then one redaction epoch (Require-Consultant 1ci.5 item 2); GlassDB keeps its own 1,000-write blocks

flat_mmr.exposed: case size: every proof carries the MMR's leaf count
flat_mmr.proof_form: one batched MMR proof per disclosure (shared siblings and peaks), M13 A8

redacted.carries: the capsule's records and the 0x05 leaf under one batched proof, the order, target membership

glassdb.audit: VerifyBlock over every block (block proof against the digest, every written key included with its value), plus order accounting
glassdb.exposed: the neighbouring entries of every disclosed leaf node (other capsules' sealed records and intake numbers), and the block count
glassdb.proof_form: current-value proof at the last block (upper path, data block, lower path) plus each earlier version through its H_prev pointer

redacted.carries: the capsule object, the order and the record key's full history under one de-duplicated node set, target membership

hash_chain_replay.parallel_note: inherently sequential: each link needs the previous head, so the all-cores audit is the one-core audit

redacted.carries: every record and the order entry, plus target membership

ours.audit_includes: every epoch's bundles and 0x05 accounting (order anchored at R_e', genuine, targeting every disposed capsule, referenced by every DISPOSE)

redacted.carries: one Tier-1 segment per epoch with its own 0x02 proof, the 0x05 proof at R_e', the order, target membership

pq_abl.audit: full-epoch verification of every epoch: recompute every h_n, rebuild, compare (eq. (1)), plus order accounting
pq_abl.exposed: each epoch's log count: every path carries it, and fixes the tree's shape
pq_abl.proof_form: one standalone O(log N) path per object against its epoch root (Phase 5 Step 3)

redacted.carries: seal object and every record with its own path against its own epoch's root (the DISPOSE against the redaction epoch's), the order with its path, target membership

method.committee_is_not_threshold: M independent ML-DSA-65 signatures: the upper bound a threshold scheme reduces to one signature
method.same_records: each case's records are built once and every scheme discloses from them
method.target: the capsule with the median chain length
method.verify: hash-level integrity from the anchored root for all three; ML-DSA verification of the disclosed records is common and reported once
